findings.summary: _NamedTextIOWrapper.__next__ raises EOFError instead of StopIteration, so iterating sys.stdin under CliRunner crashes at end of input and breaks normal loop termination; the fix is to leave __next__ alone and raise EOFError in visible_input/hidden_input when readline() returns an empty string.
The test now slices off the last two output lines (empty line and 'Aborted!') instead of asserting no exception, so pipeline tests pass despite now aborting on prompt EOF, hiding a regression.
Tests were edited to add input because old inputs (empty or none) no longer work, a backward-incompatible change for users' existing tests that CHANGES.rst does not mention.
